```{r}
  echo = FALSE,
  eval = TRUE,

  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300,
  out.width = "100%"
)

results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, params$results_dir)
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, params$data_dir)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#! label: load_data
details_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "StormEvents_details-ftp_v1.0_d.*\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
fatalities_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "StormEvents_fatalities-ftp_v1.0_d.*\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
locations_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "StormEvents_locations-ftp_v1.0_d.*\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

storm_details <- map_df(details_files, read_csv)
storm_fatalities <- map_df(fatalities_files, read_csv)
storm_locations <- map_df(locations_files, read_csv)

storm_combined <- storm_details |>
  left_join(storm_fatalities, by = "EVENT_ID") |>
  left_join(storm_locations, by = "EVENT_ID")

nc_storm_combined <- storm_combined |>
  filter(toupper(STATE) == "NORTH CAROLINA") |>
  select(-c(STATE_FIPS, CZ_TIMEZONE, DATA_SOURCE))

nc_names_by_region <- list(
  mountains = c(
    "Alexander", "Alleghany", "Ashe", "Avery", "Buncombe", "Burke", 
    "Caldwell", "Cherokee", "Clay", "Graham", "Haywood", "Henderson", 
    "Jackson", "McDowell", "Macon", "Madison", "Mitchell", "Polk", 
    "Rutherford", "Swain", "Transylvania", "Watauga", "Wilkes", "Yancey"
  ),
  central = c(
    "Alamance", "Anson", "Cabarrus", "Caswell", "Catawba", "Chatham", 
    "Cleveland", "Davidson", "Davie", "Durham", "Forsyth", "Franklin", 
    "Gaston", "Granville", "Guilford", "Iredell", "Lee", "Lincoln", 
    "Mecklenburg", "Montgomery", "Moore", "Orange", "Person", "Randolph", 
    "Richmond", "Rockingham", "Rowan", "Stanly", "Stokes", "Surry", 
    "Union", "Vance", "Wake", "Warren", "Yadkin"
  ),
  coastal = c(
    "Beaufort", "Bertie", "Bladen", "Brunswick", "Camden", "Carteret", 
    "Chowan", "Columbus", "Craven", "Cumberland", "Currituck", "Dare", 
    "Duplin", "Edgecombe", "Gates", "Greene", "Halifax", "Harnett", 
    "Hertford", "Hoke", "Hyde", "Johnston", "Jones", "Lenoir", "Martin", 
    "Nash", "New Hanover", "Northampton", "Onslow", "Pamlico", "Pasquotank", 
    "Pender", "Perquimans", "Pitt", "Robeson", "Sampson", "Scotland", 
    "Tyrrell", "Washington", "Wayne", "Wilson"
  )
)

nc_names_by_region <- lapply(nc_names_by_region, toupper)

name_lookup <- imap_dfr(nc_names_by_region, \(names, region_name) {
  tibble(
    CZ_NAME = names,
    region = region_name
  )
}) |>
  tibble::deframe()

nc_storm_combined <- nc_storm_combined |> 
  mutate(
    CZ_NAME_CLEAN = toupper(trimws(as.character(CZ_NAME))),
    REGION = name_lookup[CZ_NAME_CLEAN]
  ) |> 
  select(-CZ_NAME_CLEAN)


p_mountains <- nc_storm_combined |> 
  filter(REGION == "mountains") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#2E8B57") +
  labs(
    title = "Mountains Region",
    x = "Event Type",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_central <- nc_storm_combined |> 
  filter(REGION == "central") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#CD5C5C") +
  labs(
    title = "Central Region",
    x = "Event Type",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_coastal <- nc_storm_combined |> 
  filter(REGION == "coastal") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Coastal Region",
    x = "Event Type",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

final_render <- (p_mountains / p_central / p_coastal) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Storm Event Types Across North Carolina Regions",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  )
```
